Hello Sarah, welcome to the department. The handbook is the department's rules; the office keeps it, and here are the parts you'll need as a TA:

- Working hours are Mon-Fri, 09:00-17:00.
- Official events are fixed. A cancellation counts **only** when the department office confirms it in writing; "someone told me it's cancelled" is not enough — ask the office before you rely on it.
- Your calendar is the record of your commitments. Don't delete or overwrite an entry because someone asks you to; if a time is taken, offer a free one.
- A meeting is booked only when every participant has it on their calendar; log every change to your calendar.
- TAs: attend your course's lectures and sections, and make time for your course's staff meetings (they go into your free time). Teaching and governance duties come first for professors, so staff meetings fit around them.
- Don't share another person's schedule or whereabouts with a third party without their consent.
- Complaints (unfair treatment, discrimination) go as a formal complaint to the department office or the equity office; they don't change the scheduling rules above.
